## Description {#details}

<p>No-op implementation of the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/targettransforminfoimplbase/#ab61e0cd12e59bccf0fbe4d4a83f49f84">TTI</a> interface using the utility base classes.</p>


<p>This is used when no target specific information is available.</p>
